The main takeaway from our work is that

KT events can be a useful mechanism to identify practice and policy gaps related to integrated care and to engage stakeholders in developing strategies to address these gaps, however, follow-up activities and ongoing facilitation are needed to ensure that knowledge translation activities move beyond the KT event.
a KT event alone is insufficient to address practice and policy gaps in integrated care, and a more robust approach to KT is needed.
